entries.title: Psalms 132:1
segments: A Song of degrees. O LORD, remember David [and] all his afflictions,

entries.title: Psalms 132:2
segments: how he swore to the LORD; he vowed to the mighty One of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 132:3
segments: Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, nor go up into my bed;

entries.title: Psalms 132:4
segments: I will not give sleep to my eyes, [nor] slumber to my eyelids,

entries.title: Psalms 132:5
segments: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 132:6
segments: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah; we found it in the fields of the wood.

entries.title: Psalms 132:7
segments: We will go into His dwellings; we will worship at His footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 132:8
segments: Arise, O LORD, into Your rest; You, and the ark of Your strength.

entries.title: Psalms 132:9
segments: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:10
segments: For Your servant David's sake, turn not away the face of Your anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:11
segments: The LORD has sworn to David [in] truth; He will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body I will set on the throne for you.

entries.title: Psalms 132:12
segments: If your sons will keep My covenant and My testimonies which I shall teach them, their sons shall also sit on your throne forever.

entries.title: Psalms 132:13
segments: The LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired [it] for His dwelling-place.

entries.title: Psalms 132:14
segments: This [is] My rest forever; here I will dwell; for I have desired it.

entries.title: Psalms 132:15
segments: I will greatly bless her food; I will satisfy her poor [with] bread.

entries.title: Psalms 132:16
segments: I also will clothe her priests [with] salvation; and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:17
segments: There I will make the horn of David to bud; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 132:18
segments: I will clothe his enemies [with] shame; but his crown shall shine on him.
